value.title: Memories - Izuku Midoriya: Resolve
value.synopsis: Dopo che Izuku Midoriya incontra All Might, diventa il successore del suo Quirk, il One For All, il che significa che alla fine dovrà affrontare All For One e Tomura Shigaraki.

value.title: Memories - Toshinori Yagi: Embers
value.synopsis: All Might's last fight against All For One set off a series of events leading to his retirement as a hero, but he continues to fight, even as the embers of One For All within him die out.

value.title: Memories - Heroes: Convictions
value.synopsis: Ochaco and the Todoroki family think back about why they are fighting and reconfirm their convictions as they continue to face off against the villains.

value.title: Memories - Tomura Shigaraki: Destruction
value.synopsis: When Tomura Shigaraki was a child, a tragic accident led to the death of his family, which continues to fuel his desire to destroy.

value.title: You're Next - Movie Etiquette Class
value.synopsis: It features comical interactions that make use of the usual characters, such as Bakugo getting angry over a phone call during the screening between the current No.1 hero Endeavor and his son Shoto, and Deku getting flustered when Bakugo starts eating snacks!
